name: Perun
subtitle: Storm-Caller
description: Call the storms to your aid as you reduce your foes Turn Meters and Slow their advance in Battle.
lore: Perun, god of war and storm, is king of Vyraj’s deities—so far as they acknowledge a king. His recent efforts at uniting the pantheon have met strong resistance, not only from his brethren but his own fiercely independent nature. He seeks means of increasing his own strength, that he might cow the others into submission.
divinity_generator: Gain [20] Divinity when reducing an enemy turn meter.

awakening_bonuses.bonus: Ignore RES +20%, Divinity Multiplier +20%, DMG Multiplier +30%
Attunement Multiplier +50%, Armor Multiplier +30%, Weapon Multiplier +30%

skills.name: Static Slash
skills.description: Attack 1 enemy 2 times with a 50% chance to place [mechanic:spd-down-ii] on the target for 2 turns.
skills.awakening_bonus: Also place [INIT Down II] on the target for 2 turns.

skills.name: Lightning Strike
skills.description: Attack all enemies with a 75% chance to reduce the turn meter of each target by 20%.
skills.awakening_bonus: If a target’s turn meter is above 50% reduce their turn meter by 40% instead.

skills.name: Sky Fury
skills.description: Attack 7 times at random. Each hit has a 35% chance to decrease the target’s turn meter by 10%. Additional attacks against the same target reduces turn meter by 5%.
skills.awakening_bonus: If a target’s turn meter is reduced to 0%, place [Stun] on them for 1 turn.

skills.name: Storm Surge
skills.description: When an enemy hero has their turn meter decreased, increase this hero’s turn meter by 4%

imprint_passive: When an enemy hero has their turn meter decreased, increase this hero’s turn meter by 2%.
